source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide whether to use base-height or diagonal-product reasoning for a rhombus area.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Parallelogram is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide whether to use base-height or diagonal-product reasoning for a' is answered as parallelogram rather than rhombus.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Parallelogram is what produces rhombus, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide whether to use base-height or diagonal-product.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: rhombus is settled by running 'Decide which base and corresponding height to use for the area of a': The area of a parallelogram is base multiplied by corresponding height, and any side can — on the item about Decide whether to use base-height or diagonal-product.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Rhombus is found by dividing the given values instead of multiplying, giving 25 as the reported result — on the item about Decide whether to use base-height or diagonal-product.

intelligence.enrichment: A rhombus is a parallelogram, so base multiplied by height applies; its perpendicular bisecting diagonals also give area equal to 1/2 multiplied by the product of the diagonals.
